question: By what means does the speaker claim to have come to know the determination of the Kaula teaching?
premises: The speaker addresses the lord of the Kaulas.
The speaker states that he has become known or has come to know.
That knowledge is attributed to the grace of the one addressed.
inference: It is by the grace of the lord of the Kaulas that the speaker has come to know the Kaula determination.
uncertainties: The exact sense of jñāta here cannot be fixed solely from this verse.
plain_english: By your grace, O lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the Kaula determination.
